title: Act: Expose object id on the ActionMenu root
summary: Add data-object-id to the ActionMenu section
description: Add data-object-id={object.id} to the ActionMenu root section so the open menu is identifiable by object.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object, when ActionMenu renders, then the section has data-object-id equal to object.id
Given object undefined, when ActionMenu renders, then it still returns null
definition_of_done: Attribute rendered on the menu section

steps.action: On the <section className="action-menu" aria-label={object.name}> element add the attribute data-object-id={object.id}.
steps.expected: The rendered menu section carries data-object-id equal to the object id.
